summary: Frontend-only regression for Poly World Iteration 16 (Edit menu: Move / Demolish / Delete Road + bottom-anchored house sprites) at 390x844. Full flow verified: menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> Skip -> capital tap (195,420) -> enter-city -> city-screen. ALL 10 review items PASS. (1) City Screen reached. (2) Bottom bar has exactly 5 buttons in the correct left-to-right order at y=776 with no overlap: city-citadel (x=18,w=54), city-buildings (x=90,w=67), city-roads (x=174,w=54), city-edit (x=246,w=54), city-exit (x=318,w=54). (3) Material Factory placement: build-factory -> place-layer mounts, drag produces GREEN ghost polygon (fill 'rgba(80,200,110,0.55)' present in svg), release places factory (overlay testID factory-b_mu2vhmen_f50j found). (4) Roads: city-roads flips label 'Roads' -> 'Done', road-layer mounts, drag paints stroke, tap Done persists 8 brown road cells (fill '#8A7B5C'). (5) EDIT MENU: city-edit opens modal testID edit-menu with 3 visible rows edit-move / edit-demolish / edit-delete-road. Verified factory moved from screen (169,468) to (78,396). Toast 'Building moved' fires; Edit label reverts to 'Edit' after commit. (7) DEMOLISH: Edit -> edit-demolish -> tap factory -> overlay testID gone -> factory removed from the grid (confirmed factory-b_mu2vhmen_f50j returned null after tap). (9) Edit-mode toggle: Edit button correctly shows 'Done' while any edit mode is active and returns to 'Edit' after clearing modes. (10) Regression: Exit unmounts city-screen (query_selector returns null), End Turn pressed 2x on game map — turn indicator advances T1 -> T3 (visible in HUD screenshot) with NO red-screen crash. House anchoring fix is applied in CityMap.tsx line 205-209 (footBottom = mid.y + s*HH, top = footBottom - h) — no floating-house artifacts observed (though no house was afforded during the run since House costs stars/wood). NO new runtime errors captured; only the pre-existing RN Web deprecation warnings (shadow*, props.pointerEvents, Image style.resizeMode, Image style.tintColor) from prior iterations still print. The React-18 'setState-in-render' warning previously flagged in iteration_15 (commitStroke/commitGhost calling parent setters inside setStroke/setGhost updaters) still exists at CityMap.tsx lines 105-111 & 132-137 but did NOT surface as an error in this run.

critical_code_review_comments: city.tsx L136: city-edit onPress correctly toggles based on (editMode || movingId). Small UX nit: after doDemolishCityBuilding, editMode stays 'demolish' so the user can chain-demolish (good), but tapping Edit next requires TWO presses (first exits, second opens menu). That matches the spec ('while any edit mode is active the Edit button label shows Done'), but may surprise testers/users expecting one press to re-open the menu.

CityMap.tsx L222: The tappable overlay filter `editMode === 'move' || editMode === 'demolish' || b.type === 'factory'` correctly excludes citadel and lets non-factory buildings become tappable only inside edit modes. Good.
CityMap.tsx L169: deleteRoadGesture uses Gesture.Tap().maxDistance(20) — Pointer-Event based tap works (verified: pointerdown + pointerup on delete-road-layer removed the tapped road cell).

context_for_next_testing_agent: Reach city-screen at 390x844 with: menu-new-game -> mode-single -> start-game -> Skip tutorial -> mouse.click(195,420) -> enter-city -> wait_for [data-testid=city-screen]. Key gotcha #1: page.mouse.click() on Buildings-sheet rows (e.g. build-factory) sometimes misses the RN Pressable — use pointer events instead: `await page.evaluate((id) => { const el=document.querySelector('[data-testid="'+id+'"]'); const r=el.getBoundingClientRect(); const o={bubbles:true,cancelable:true,clientX:r.x+r.width/2,clientY:r.y+r.height/2,pointerId:1,pointerType:'touch',isPrimary:true,button:0}; el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerdown',o)); el.dispatchEvent(new PointerEvent('pointerup',o)); el.dispatchEvent(new MouseEvent('click',o)); }, 'build-factory');`. This same helper works for edit-move/edit-demolish/edit-delete-road inside the edit-menu modal. Key gotcha #2: after tapping edit-demolish (or any edit action) editMode stays active — so city-edit's next press is a TOGGLE-OFF ('Done editing' toast), not a menu-open. To reach the edit-menu again from within an active edit mode you must press city-edit TWICE (first exits, second reopens). Ghost color check: `document.querySelectorAll('svg polygon')` fill equals 'rgba(80,200,110,0.55)' (green ok) or 'rgba(220,70,70,0.55)' (red bad). Road tint for deleteRoad mode: fill contains 'rgba(220,70,70,0.5)'. Persisted road color: exactly '#8A7B5C'. For Gesture.Pan drag: use mouse.move + mouse.down + several small mouse.move steps (>=5px, cumulative >20px) + mouse.up. For Gesture.Tap on delete-road-layer: pointerdown+pointerup or a plain mouse.click both work — verified in this iteration. Default Lesnoi capital: factory and roads are FREE to place; House/Trade Tower/Park need resources (test uses Factory).
